correctness.rationale: Exact commuting-tensor factorization proves the Walsh-mode product; finite cosine Fourier expansion gives all Cesàro eigenvalues and rank. Signed cancellation is equivalent in both directions to distinct subset sums. Singleton finite-window modes force time multiples of \(\pi/(2g)\) by Bézout; all nonzero integer cosine frequencies then integrate exactly to zero. Sorted integer weights saturating the pigeonhole budget are uniquely binary via a nonnegative generating-polynomial induction; the instantaneous criterion follows from odd quarter-turn phases and the two-adic valuations. The actual standalone verifier independently reconstructs spectral projector Schur squares and exact ranks for 21 profiles (5,124 entries), exhaustive bounded budget checks (3,164 cases), and 88 finite-window tests; finite verification is not asserted to prove unbounded dimensions.
